## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A two-*juan* (上 / 下) Yuán-period commentary by **Gǔyún Yuáncuì** 古雲元粹 of Tiáoxī (Húzhōu) on Dìguān's *Tiāntái sìjiào yí* ([KR6d0168](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0168), T1931). Body attribution: *Tiáoxī shāmén Yuáncuì shù* 苕谿沙門　元粹　述. The composition is bracketed within Yuáncuì's productive period c. 1214–1290 (extending the bracket beyond his documented productive years to allow for late activity).

**Abstract**

Yuáncuì's *Bèishì* belongs to the substantial Sòng-Yuán commentarial tradition on Dìguān's *Sìjiào yí*. As a dharma-disciple of [北峰宗印](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%8C%97%E5%B3%B0%E5%AE%97%E5%8D%B0) Běifēng Zōngyìn (1148–1213), Yuáncuì represents the late-Sòng / early-Yuán Tiāntái scholastic tradition's continued engagement with the Tiāntái doctrinal-classification framework.
